description: This file contains unit tests for the PolicyModifyCommandAdapter class, verifying its behavior with various policy modification commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It uses JUnit and parameterized testing to test different command scenarios such as create, modify, and delete policies, resources, subjects, and entries.

classes.name: ParametrizedPolicyModifyCommandAdapterTest
classes.description: A parameterized JUnit test class that tests the PolicyModifyCommandAdapter with various policy modification commands such as create, modify, and delete operations for policies, resources, subjects, and entries.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the PolicyModifyCommandAdapter instance before each test execution.

methods.name: underTest
methods.description: Provides the current instance of the adapter under test.

methods.name: defaultChannel
methods.description: Returns the default channel for topic path used in tests.

methods.name: createPolicy
methods.description: Creates test parameters for the 'create policy' command scenario.

methods.name: modifyPolicy
methods.description: Creates test parameters for the 'modify policy' command scenario.

methods.name: deletePolicy
methods.description: Creates test parameters for the 'delete policy' command scenario.

methods.name: modifyPolicyEntry
methods.description: Creates test parameters for the 'modify policy entry' command scenario.

methods.name: deletePolicyEntry
methods.description: Creates test parameters for the 'delete policy entry' command scenario.

methods.name: modifyPolicyEntries
methods.description: Creates test parameters for modifying multiple policy entries.

methods.name: modifyResource
methods.description: Creates test parameters for modifying a resource within a policy.

methods.name: deleteResource
methods.description: Creates test parameters for deleting a resource from a policy.

methods.name: modifyResources
methods.description: Creates test parameters for modifying multiple resources within a policy.

methods.name: modifySubject
methods.description: Creates test parameters for modifying a subject within a policy.

methods.name: deleteSubject
methods.description: Creates test parameters for deleting a subject from a policy.

methods.name: modifySubjects
methods.description: Creates test parameters for modifying multiple subjects within a policy.
